plugins.name: rightsize
plugins.description: Opus where it counts, rightsize everywhere else. rightsize picks the model and effort for each Claude Code prompt: routine work stays on Sonnet, reviews switch to Opus for one turn, and big routine jobs from an Opus session can go to a cheaper helper. A band shows what it did and what it cost, and watch-only mode lets you see its calls before it changes anything.
